eligibility_tiers.line: The Dual Enrollment Program is limited to juniors and seniors who have achieved a minimum of 3.0 GPA and wish to take a course at Cal State
Typically, dual enrollment is reserved for high school juniors and seniors who have 2.5 or higher high school GPAs.
